title: Enemies: E1 variations
desc: Three new fear creatures for 812 E1 Dread Wisp (IMPROVE, no note), each built a different way, playing idle, attack and death; E2 and E3 were dropped.

takes.name: Veil Wisp
takes.facts: hooded crown, shroud of 14 hanging strips, one big yellow eye inside; attack: shroud opens like petals, eye pushes out, gaze beam pins the player (freezes, shivers); death: eye bursts, strips wilt, falls to dark pixels; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot

takes.name: Mask Swarm
takes.facts: smoky core with ten floating masks (yellow eye slits); attack: masks ring the player's head facing in, blinking every 4 ticks, the player cowers; death: core pops, masks go dark, drop and crumble; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot

takes.name: Stilt Stalker
takes.facts: dark body on four stilt legs, telescoping neck, caged head with three eyes; attack: leans in, neck slides to the player's face, eyes open, yellow fear pool, player stumbles back; death: legs buckle one by one, dissolves top down; idle 1-40, attack 41-80 at a player stand-in, death 81-130 after a construct shot
